articles.title: FIFA wanted Avalanche's blockchain to help curb World Cup ticket scalping. Here's how it's going
articles.snippet: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're looking at how FIFA is using the Avalanche blockchain to test out a new ticketing system.

articles.title: Kevin Warsh's first Fed meeting could be more about communication than rates
articles.snippet: While monetary policy is expected to remain unchanged, markets are focused on whether the new chair begins reshaping how the U.S. central bank communicates.

articles.title: A new Bittensor proposal would turn validators into something like fund managers
articles.snippet: Root Reborn would have TAO validators pick which subnets to back and reinvest yield into, rather than constantly selling subnet tokens to pay stakers. It is a code proposal in review, not a live change.

articles.title: SpaceX's $2.6 trillion market cap nearly double that of bitcoin
articles.snippet: Eight days after its IPO, SpaceX has surged past $2.5 trillion to become the world's sixth-largest company. And market watchers say it is pulling the risk capital crypto wants.

articles.title: XRP gives back breakout gains, slipping below $1.23 on heavy selling
articles.snippet: XRP briefly traded above key resistance before sellers stepped in, with rising volume suggesting traders used the rally to cut positions rather than add risk.
